steps.name: Power On HP ProLiant Server
steps.description: Initiates power sequence for the HP ProLiant server hardware via the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Shutdown HP ProLiant Server
steps.description: Executes a graceful shutdown sequence for the HP ProLiant server hardware via the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Check HP ProLiant Server Status
steps.description: Queries the server's Integrated Lights-Out (iLO) management interface to verify operational status and health metrics.

steps.name: Activate iLO Management Interface
steps.description: Enables the Integrated Lights-Out (iLO) management system on the HP ProLiant server at the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Check if iLO Management Interface is active
steps.description: Check if the Integrated Lights-Out (iLO) management system is active on the HP ProLiant server at the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Deactivate iLO Management Interface
steps.description: Disables the Integrated Lights-Out (iLO) management system on the HP ProLiant server to conserve resources when not needed.

steps.name: Check if XenServer is running
steps.description: Check if the XenServer hypervisor and node are running at the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Deploy Kubernetes Node on XenServer
steps.description: Provisions and initializes a new Kubernetes node virtual machine (k8s-node-1) on the XenServer hypervisor at the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Deploy Minecraft Game Server
steps.description: Creates and initializes a Minecraft game server container using Kubernetes on the server at the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

steps.name: Terminate Minecraft Game Server
steps.description: Gracefully shuts down the Minecraft game server container and releases associated resources on the server at the specified IP address (192.168.1.100).

pipelines.name: Minecraft Server Deployment Pipeline
pipelines.description: Comprehensive workflow to verify system resources, power on infrastructure, activate management interfaces, and deploy a Minecraft game server environment.

pipelines.name: Stop Minecraft Server Pipeline
pipelines.description: Comprehensive workflow to stop the Minecraft game server environment.

pipelines.name: Stop Minecraft Server & cluster node Pipeline
pipelines.description: Comprehensive workflow to stop the Minecraft game server environment and the cluster node on XenServer.
